description: Resonance Intelligence — detects when multiple independent macro forces are oscillating in phase across 28 signals in 5 domains, amplifying each other rather than cancelling. Returns per-signal phase angles, resonance clusters (groups of 3+ aligned signals), amplitude amplification factor, system resonance score (0–100), and historical danger-zone comparison to crisis precedents (2008, 2011, 2020, 1997 EM).
name: intelligence.resonance
